messages:
elaine-cs: Kicking off Caspian dedicated bring-up check. Need final agreement on quota, autoscale curve, loadtest cadence, and customer-facing notes. Their renewal is sensitive so we need clean numbers.

sam-ops: Current committed quota = 1,500 qps. Proposal: autoscale min=150, target=700, max=1400, scale_step=100, cool_down=45s. Reason: smoother increments for chat workloads.

mike-eng: That looks fine. Suggest we shadow-run traffic for 24h before main loadtest to catch warm-cache behaviour. For the official test: 45m steady at 700 qps, then three progressive bursts (900, 1100, 1400) 3m each with 7m recovery.

lina-ml: We'll enable prefix caching and async KV warming. Expect ~12% effective qps reduction after warmup. Also enabling model-variant routing: prefer gpt-small-q on poolA, fallback to gpt-base-fp16.

josh-prod: Let's document rollback criteria so Caspian's SRE knows when to flip to fallback. Customer requirement: visible error spikes = 0, p95 < 250ms during steady.

mike-eng: Rollback triggers I propose: sustained error_rate > 0.8% for 5m OR p95 > 450ms for 4m. On trigger: switch traffic to hosted route and abort remaining bursts.

sam-ops: I'll add a cross-tenant guardrail: throttle_burst_limit to avoid noisy neighbor bleed. Also will set temporary ingress caps on the cluster during the test window.

elaine-cs: Can someone paste the k6 commands and the Grafana dashboard panels so I can forward to Caspian? They want to prep their network team.

mike-eng: k6 commands below (will use their shadow key):

```
// steady phase
k6 run --vus 700 --duration 45m steady-chat.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.caspian.redwood/v1/chat

// burst phases
k6 run --vus 900 --duration 3m burst1.js
k6 run --vus 1100 --duration 3m burst2.js
k6 run --vus 1400 --duration 3m burst3.js
```

lina-ml: Dashboard panels to share: poolA_p95_latency, poolA_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_variant_fallbacks, tokens_per_second, scaling_events. I'll export a short permalink after tests.

elaine-cs: Good. Also capture cost delta for token spend during bursts — finance will want that for renewal conversation.

sam-ops: Will include token-cost estimate + actuals in postmortem. ETA for report: next-day morning after test.

mike-eng: Plan timeline: Tue 06:00 UTC start; 00:00-06:00 shadow warmup (traffic replay), 06:00 steady phase, then bursts. I'll post logs and Grafana links to this thread.

josh-prod: deploy-bot says the gpt-small-q canary to poolA finished earlier.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q -> poolA at 1719995120 :white_check_mark:

elaine-cs: Action items: Mike run test Tue 06:00 UTC; Sam enforce autoscale knobs + guardrails; Lina set up dashboard + export; Mike+Sam deliver post-test report; I'll prepare customer brief with SLO screenshots.

mike-eng: Ack. I'll also capture slow-path stack traces if p95 drifts during bursts.

sam-ops: I'll pre-authorize rollback to hosted route with oncall and have contacts ready.

elaine-cs: Thanks team. I'll message Caspian to confirm the window and tell them we'll share the runbook snippet and thresholds. Please flag anything I should avoid sending to customer (shadow keys, internal run links).

mike-eng: I'll redact keys and only share public endpoints + grafana view links.

elaine-cs: Perfect. Closing notes: needs post-test summary for renewal advocacy. Let's be crisp on p95/p99, error taxonomy, and scaling events.
